title: Associations of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) Susceptibility Variants Across the CLL Etiologic Continuum.
snippet: Low-count monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis (LC-MBL) is a precursor to chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). title: Hypoxia-Associated Glycolytic-Lipogenic Reprogramming and Impaired Antigen Presentation in SPP1Tumor-Associated Macrophages in Ovarian Cancer.
